# Roadmap

> The public roadmap of a content hub: phases and items with their status (planned, in progress, done).

The page reads `/public/v1/roadmap` (JSON) on this host, and `/public/v1/snapshot` for the latest signed record of it.
Automated clients should prefer the machine-readable roadmap and feeds, which are published on a separate host for machines
(`/public/v1/roadmap-bot`, `/public/v1/feed.json`, `/public/v1/snapshot`).

The signed record: the roadmap is also stored on Walrus as a canonical JSON document signed as a Sui personal message. To
verify it, fetch the blob, check its SHA-256, then verify the signature with `verifyPersonalMessageSignature` from
`@mysten/sui` and check that the signing address is the signer you expect.
